title: Multilinear extension of a predicate
statement: Let $P$ be a predicate of arity $k$, and assign a real number $\mu_i$ to each input position $i$. Define its multilinear extension to be the sum, over all subsets $S$ of input positions, of the Fourier coefficient of the indicator of $P$ at $S$ multiplied by $\prod_{i\in S}\mu_i$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mu_i$ is real for each input position $i$
